enunciado: You have names {"Ana", "Luis", "Eva", "Juan", "Sofi"} and points {85, 92, 85, 70, 92}. Sort them from highest to lowest score with insertion sort (stable), moving name and points together. Notice that ties keep their original order.
pistas: Every time you move a score, move its name too.
For descending order shift while points[j] < key.
With strict <, ties do not jump ahead: the sort is stable.
